title: Mobile testing: /MobDev screen URLs
idea: A dev URL that opens one demo screen directly and full-screen on a real phone, loading only that screen's code.

glossary.meaning: One demo page that can be opened on its own (e.g. a quest island, the log-in form). Named by a short string in the URL.

The PascalCase name of a screen as it appears in the URL (e.g. 'QuestShoot'). The list: GameScene, QuestOriginal, QuestShoot, QuestDodge, QuestDoor, SignUp, LogIn, InfoRecovery, EditInfo, DialogBubble.
The new dev route that serves screens by name for testing on a real phone.
The existing desktop page (/MobileTester) that shows a screen inside a phone-sized frame picked from 20 device sizes.
An optional query value that tweaks a screen (island number, joystick sensitivity). Missing = the screen's default.
The page at plain /MobDev: one link per screen type, nothing else loaded.

features.name: Screen route
features.whatItDoes: Opening /MobDev/<screen type> shows that screen full-screen, with only its own code downloaded.
details: A screen type that isn't in the list shows a not-found page.
Screens (10, same as the MobileTester dropdown): GameScene, QuestOriginal, QuestShoot, QuestDodge, QuestDoor, SignUp, LogIn, InfoRecovery, EditInfo, DialogBubble.

features.name: Screen list
features.whatItDoes: Plain /MobDev shows one tap-sized link per screen type.
details: Static page; loads no game code.
Links carry no settings; add ?island= / ?sens= by hand.

features.name: Screen settings
features.whatItDoes: Optional query values tweak the chosen screen.
details: island=N picks the island for the game scene (default 1).

features.name: Old route cleanup
features.whatItDoes: /Dev/Quest* folders and /Dev?Island=N are removed; home-form buttons link to /MobDev/<screen type>.
details: /MobDev needs no login and works on the deployed Vercel build, like /Dev today.

features.name: Quest leave
features.whatItDoes: On a quest screen, the leave action (Elena's はい) goes back to the screen list at /MobDev.
details: Applies to QuestOriginal, QuestShoot, QuestDodge, QuestDoor.

flows.name: Test a screen on a phone
steps: Open <host>/MobDev on the phone (local Wi-Fi or the Vercel URL)
Only that screen's code loads; it fills the phone screen
Play / test; for a quest, Elena's はい at the end goes back to /MobDev
Optionally edit the URL to /MobDev/GameScene?island=2&sens=1.5 to change settings

examples.whatHappens: The door quest fills the screen; the other 9 screens' code is not downloaded.
List of 10 links, one per screen type.

leftOut: Settings controls on the page itself (settings only via the URL)

decisions.decision: URL shape is /MobDev/<screen type> (path segment), not ?screen=. Why: Each screen is prebuilt as its own page and the phone downloads only that screen's code; no client-side search-param read before drawing.
/MobDev covers the same 10 screens as the MobileTester dropdown. Why: one list of testable screens.

/Dev/QuestShoot, /Dev/QuestDodge, /Dev/QuestDoor, /Dev/QuestOriginal and /Dev?Island=N are replaced by /MobDev; /MobileTester stays as the desktop phone-frame viewer; home-form buttons point to /MobDev. Why: One full-screen dev route instead of a folder per screen.
Small settings go in optional query values with defaults (e.g. ?island=2&sens=1.5). Why: Screen name stays in the path; tweaks don't need new routes.
Plain /MobDev is a static link list of all screen types.
A quest's leave action on /MobDev goes back to /MobDev.
/MobDev is reachable without login, in dev and in the deployed Vercel build, like /Dev.

Screen types are PascalCase: GameScene, QuestOriginal, QuestShoot, QuestDodge, QuestDoor, SignUp, LogIn, InfoRecovery, EditInfo, DialogBubble. QuestOriginal and InfoRecovery keep the names of the existing routes.
